title: fix(metadata): parse a string updated_at from frontmatter

files.patch:
@@ -50,10 +50,17 @@ def apply_fallbacks_and_defaults(to:)
         to[:twitter_card] ||= "summary_large_image"
         to[:og_url] = canonical_url
         to[:article_published_time] = @resource.published_at
+        to[:updated_at] = parse_time(to[:updated_at]) if to[:updated_at].is_a?(String)
 
         to.compact
       end
 
+      def parse_time(value)
+        Time.zone.parse(value)
+      rescue ArgumentError
+        nil
+      end
+
       def canonical_url
         return @frontmatter[:canonical_url] if @frontmatter[:canonical_url]
         return Rails.application.routes.url_helpers.root_url(**Perron.configuration.default_url_options) if @resource.root?

@@ -158,4 +158,25 @@ def setup
 
     assert_equal 'Dummy App', metadata.title, 'Title should fall back to the configured site_name'
   end
+
+  test 'parses a string updated_at from frontmatter into a time' do
+    metadata = Perron::Resource::Metadata.new(
+      resource: @post,
+      frontmatter: { updated_at: '2023-05-15' },
+      collection: @posts_collection
+    ).data
+
+    assert_kind_of Time, metadata.updated_at
+    assert_equal '2023-05-15', metadata.updated_at.to_date.iso8601
+  end
+
+  test 'drops an unparseable updated_at from frontmatter' do
+    metadata = Perron::Resource::Metadata.new(
+      resource: @post,
+      frontmatter: { updated_at: 'not a date' },
+      collection: @posts_collection
+    ).data
+
+    assert_nil metadata.updated_at
+  end
 end
